classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: steady chopping (1), periodic stirring during an unattended simmer (1), one pot, toppings are raw assembly (trivial finish = 0), sauté/simmer technique (0). Sum 2 = easy. Complexity: 18 countable ingredients (oil/salt excluded) -> count band 2; every item is mainstream supermarket (0 specialty, 0 sourcing); one seasoning profile (0). Sum 2 = standard. WAVE proposal was simple; the rubric gives standard purely on list length (many single spices + toppings), not specialty burden.
